'''Copper ore''' can be mined at level 1 [[Mining]] providing 17.5 Mining experience. After mining [[copper rocks]], it will take 2.4 seconds until it reappears. Copper ore is used with [[tin ore]] to smelt [[bronze bar]]s, or used with [[nickel ore]] to smelt [[Cupronickel bar|Cupronickel bars]]. Smelting a bronze bar gives 6.2 [[Smithing]] experience.
